items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: But for that particular show, with Ethel Waters, he wrote the music, and I used to do all the extractions on them.

ctx.x: And at the Cotton Club, he wrote new music for those shows, too?
Not for all the shows; sometimes they used to have somebody else. But for that particular show, with Ethel Waters, he wrote the music, and I used to do all the extractions on them.
And for the Ziegfeld Follies, did he write the music for that, too?
